summary: FiscalNote Holdings sold its subsidiary owning FrontierView to Oxford Economics USA for total value up to ~$9.4M, consisting of $6.4M cash at closing plus up to $3.0M earnout tied to ARR targets by Sept/Dec 2026; $1.0M held in escrow. Proceeds prepaid $4.95M term loans under MGG financing agreement. The deal closed Aug 27, 2026. Watch for earnout achievement and balance sheet impact.
